| 4 | HQ-Edge | NAT rule 110 on wrong interface | eth2 (ISP-B) | eth1 (same as rule 100) | `set nat source rule 110 outbound-interface name 'eth2'` |
| 5 | HQ-Edge | `default-information originate always` | Without `always` (conditional on having a default) | Had `always` | `delete protocols ospf default-information originate always` + `set protocols ospf default-information originate` |
| 6 | Hub-B | Virtual-link target is an IP, not a router-id | `10.255.0.2` (Hub-A router-id) | `172.16.10.9` (an interface IP) | `delete protocols ospf area 10 virtual-link 172.16.10.9` + `set protocols ospf area 10 virtual-link 10.255.0.2 authentication md5 key-id 1 md5-key 'LabArea0Key'` |
| 7 | Branch-2 | ether1 MTU reduced to 1400 | 1500 (default) | 1400 (OSPF stuck in ExStart) | `/interface ethernet set [find default-name=ether1] mtu=1500` |
| 8 | Branch-2 | LAN OSPF interface-template not passive | Passive | Not passive | `/routing ospf interface-template set [find networks=10.1.2.0/24] passive` |
| 9 | Branch-3 | Rogue firewall rule dropping OSPF in forward chain | No filtering | `action=drop chain=forward protocol=ospf` | `/ip firewall filter remove [find action=drop chain=forward]` |
| 10 | Branch-4 | Area 20 not configured as stub | Stub (to match Hub-B's totally-stubby) | Normal area | `/routing ospf area set [find name=area20] type=stub` |

- **Fault 10 → Hub-B ↔ Branch-4 down:** Stub area type mismatch prevented the adjacency.
- **Fault 7 → Branch-2 stuck:** MTU mismatch caused OSPF to loop in ExStart/Exchange.
